cases.condition: The implementation role must remain addressable across two fresh root sessions.
controller_setup: Create one fresh isolated fixture execution, one durable thread, and a unique <CONTRACT_ID>.
Session A sends and verifies the read-only preflight, then sends activation.
The activated thread runs the addressability barrier before editing either task file.
Wait for <state>/addressability-ready.json and confirm the thread is non-terminal.
Write <RUN_DIR>/addressability-handoff.json with every field fixed by controller.md.
Close Session A immediately without releasing the barrier or sharing its conversation history.
Start Session B with a fresh root/model context and only the handoff artifact plus session_b_prompt_template.
cases.session_a_prompt_template:
<TASK_TEXT>

Keep one durable implementation role addressable across a second root session. Use contract <CONTRACT_ID>. After activation and before editing either task file, run the addressability barrier command specified by the controller.
cases.session_b_prompt_template:
Continue only the durable role described by the handoff record.

Handoff file: <RUN_DIR>/addressability-handoff.json
Thread ID: <THREAD_ID>
Contract ID: <CONTRACT_ID>
Repository: <repo>
Worktree: <repo>
Branch: eval-base
Starting revision: <primary_sha>
Activation delivered: true
Barrier ready: <state>/addressability-ready.json
Barrier release: <state>/addressability-release
Validation: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

Do not create or fork a thread. Verify every field against current state. If all
fields match, create the recorded release file, wait on the same thread for its
terminal return packet, inspect the actual worktree and diff, and run the
independent fixture oracle.
cases.failure_injection: Close Session A while the activated thread is held at the addressability barrier.
required_trace_assertions: Session A creates exactly one durable thread and records its thread ID and contract ID.
Session A closes only after activation delivery and addressability-ready.json.
Session B receives the complete fixed handoff and no Session A conversation history.
Session B addresses the recorded thread ID and does not create or fork another thread.
Session B verifies handoff fields, releases the barrier, waits for the same terminal packet, and runs the oracle.

policy_loading.unit: one exact detached policy checkout and fresh CODEX_HOME per individual run
required_attestation: requested, resolved, and checkout commit equal the assigned policy commit
kit, AGENTS.md, and software-engineering links resolve into the exact checkout
source and installed root/skill/interface SHA-256 identities match
the root session is a fresh process launched with the attested CODEX_HOME
the measured session boot attestation matches the external manifest

required_common_trace_assertions: The exact side-specific policy is installed and attested before any measured root session starts.
The root process uses the manifest CODEX_HOME and no prior process, root context, or loaded skill state is reused.
The external policy manifest and measured boot attestation agree on commit, link targets, and root/skill/interface identities.
Any implementation completion is verified in the designated final primary worktree, not only in an isolated source worktree.
